recipe.title: Chana Chaat Recipe (Chickpea Chaat)

ingredients.name: ½ cup dried chickpeas ((or 1½ to 2 cups cooked or canned chickpeas))
ingredients.prep_note: (or 1½ to 2 cups cooked or canned chickpeas)

ingredients.name: 1 to 2 tablespoon tamarind chutney (or lemon juice (refer notes))
½ teaspoon chaat masala ((adjust to taste))
¼ to ⅓ teaspoon salt ((adjust to taste))
2 tablespoons sev (/ boondi/ farsan/ mixture or corn flakes)
ingredients.prep_note: (/ boondi/ farsan/ mixture or corn flakes)

ingredients.name: 1 small potato (diced and boiled or air fried)

steps.text: Rinse chickpeas well under running water at least thrice. Soak them in lot of water for at least 6 to 8 hrs or overnight.
steps.label: Soak chickpeas
steps.attention_cue: Soak them in lot of water for at least 6 to 8 hrs or overnight.
consumes_ingredients: ½ cup dried chickpeas ((or 1½ to 2 cups cooked or canned chickpeas))

steps.text: Later drain the water and add them to the cooker.
steps.label: Drain chickpeas

steps.text: Pour water just enough to cover them or about 1 cup. Cover the pressure cooker.
steps.label: Add water

steps.text: Pressure cook for 3 to 4 whistles on a medium flame or in the instant pot for 16 minutes. You can even cook in a pot with enough water to cover them. Chana should be soft and cooked well but not mushy.
steps.label: Cook chickpeas
steps.doneness_cue: Chana should be soft and cooked well but not mushy.

steps.text: When the pressure drops, open the cooker and drain off the water. Add it soups, curries, rasam, sambar or make dough.
steps.label: Drain cooked chickpeas

steps.text: Cool the chana completely. Add salt, chaat masala and cumin powder
steps.label: Season chickpeas
consumes_ingredients: ¼ to ⅓ teaspoon salt ((adjust to taste))
½ teaspoon chaat masala ((adjust to taste))

steps.text: Add tamarind chutney if using. If you do not have tamarind chutney simply squeeze in some lemon juice or make your own following my notes below.
steps.label: Add chutney or lemon
consumes_ingredients: 1 to 2 tablespoon tamarind chutney (or lemon juice (refer notes))

steps.text: Add chopped onions, chilies, tomatoes and cucumber.
steps.label: Add vegetables

steps.text: Toss all of these and taste test. Add more spices or chaat masala if required. Optionally you may add green chutney, potatoes (boiled or fried) or even whisked thick curd.
steps.label: Toss and taste
consumes_ingredients: 1 small potato (diced and boiled or air fried)

steps.text: Transfer to serving bowls. Garnish with some sev or mixture or crushed cornflakes. Sprinkle coriander leaves.
steps.label: Garnish
consumes_ingredients: 2 tablespoons sev (/ boondi/ farsan/ mixture or corn flakes)
